verdict.label: Generalization Support
verdict.rule: Support when Hit@10 is maintained or improved, no BM25 Hit@10 query is lost, at least one H10-only Hit@10 recovery exists, requirement loss is zero or the gain is strictly larger, and no ranking drop exceeds 0.05. Failure when Hit@10 falls, a ranking drop exceeds that frozen limit, or requirement losses exceed gains. Otherwise Neutral / Mixed. DEV numerator floors are not reused.

decision.statement: DEV에서 failure mechanism 기반으로 선택한 BM25-primary asymmetric policy가 독립 TEST에서도 BM25 baseline을 보존하면서 semantic miss를 추가 복구했다.
